title: Ayah input bundle
description: One bundle per ayah, produced by scripts/build_bundle.py. See COMMENTARY_SPEC.md §9 for the source inventory and §6 for the evidence rules this bundle exists to satisfy (never filter inter-ayah rows by label; report gaps rather than filling them). A surah bundle (bundle_type=surah, see the $defs.surahBundle definition at the bottom of this file) is the ordered set of its ayah bundles plus surah-scope material; it references ayah bundle files by name rather than embedding them.

text.description: Arabic text from quran-data/data/text/quran-uthmani.tsv (pipe-delimited S:A|text rows).

qac_morphemes.description: Full rows from qac_morphemes for this ayah, ordered by word_index then morpheme_index. Column set matches the qac.sqlite.gz schema verbatim; empty root_join_key means no root.

word_analysis.description: The FULL word-analysis-output-v2 record for this ayah, verbatim: every words[] entry with its prose and all topics[] (do not summarise, do not keep only gloss_range).

items.description: Passed through verbatim from the source record; not re-validated field-by-field here because it is foreign-schema content owned by the word-analysis pipeline.

branch_inventories.description: Keyed by variant name, normally 'full_context_packet'. The default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets; it uses the surah-scope full_context_packet.json and narrows that fallback to this ayah -- roots occurring in the ayah keep EVERY branch unconditionally (Layer 2 selects nothing; PRINCIPLES.md §3/§6), plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here keep only their cited branches. Consult coverage.branch_inventories.scoping for what was retained, by which rule, and what was dropped: a root absent here may be a deliberate scoping decision, NOT a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.description: Retired default-lane source. Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are no longer consumed by normal commentary bundles. The field is kept as an explicit empty object with coverage.v12_reader_responses.present=false so agents report absence rather than infer staged focus movement.

v12_reader_walks.description: Keyed by reader label (reader_a, reader_b, ...). Per-ayah excerpt parsed out of reader_s{NNN}_{a,b}_ayah_walk.md by ayah heading.

turkish_prose_synthesis_md.description: From the file's separate '# Turkish Prose Synthesis' section, when present. Null if that reader's walk file has no such section (verified true for reader_b on S103).

v12_reader_walks_wide.description: Keyed by reader label. Per-ayah excerpt parsed out of the plus/minus-5 / 11-ayah-context reader_s{NNN}_*_ayah_walk.md files. Kept separate from v12_reader_walks so consumers can distinguish ordinary full-context walks from wider-window reader evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.description: Compact final v12-cross-run publication row for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader families. Use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose. Null when the publication row is absent.

butuncul_okuma_line.description: The per-ayah line from the whole-surah reading ({NNN}-0-{N}-butuncul-okuma.md), parsed into arabic_text / reading_text_tr / root_citations, plus the raw_line verbatim. Null if no whole-surah reading file exists or it has no line for this ayah.

inter_ayah_rows.description: ALL rows for this focus ayah from analysis/inter-ayah/focus_{S}_{A}_cutoff_100.tsv, every label including weak and 'no value'. Never filtered. Consumers order by the label axis; they must not use it to include/exclude (COMMENTARY_SPEC.md §6.2).

word_morpheme_spans.description: Parallel to word_analysis.words[]. Each element resolves that critical word to a span of QAC morphemes via linguistic/morphemes.tsv, or is null when unresolved (see coverage.word_morpheme_spans.unresolved for the reason). USE THIS for any word-level join between word_analysis topics and QAC morphology: word_analysis[].aligned_qac_word_ref is preserved verbatim but is the wrong unit type (critical words are orthographic/analytic units; e.g. 100:1 وَ and ٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ are two critical words but one QAC word). aligned_qac_word_ref is deliberately NOT corrected -- renumbering would fabricate identities (PRINCIPLES.md §11 / basmalah no-hidden-renumbering rule).

aligned_qac_word_ref_upstream.description: The upstream value, kept so the discrepancy stays inspectable. Do not join on it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.description: Subchannels from the network-v3 first-pass channel review (analysis/channels/network-v3/s{NNN}/review/reader_a_pilot.md) whose ayah anchors include this ayah, each carrying its parent channel's semantic_invariant/surprising_reach so the block reads standalone. First-pass single-reader output, not an adjudicated ledger (see coverage.channel_review).

channel_generated_outputs.description: Lightweight manifest for generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path files available in quran-data for this surah. Contents are not inlined because these files can be large; agents with file access may read only the listed files when channel detail is necessary. These files are candidate/family/path evidence, not an adjudicated channel ledger.

pericope.description: The single pericope (thematic ayah-span) this ayah belongs to, from analysis/channels/network-v3/pericopes/surah_pericopes.jsonl. Surahs absent from that index (single-pericope by definition) get one synthesized row spanning the whole surah, flagged via synthesized=true. Null only if no pericope span covers this ayah (data gap; see coverage.pericope).

root_lexicon.description: Keyed by root_id (e.g. 'root_000745'). One entry per distinct root appearing in this ayah's qac_morphemes (root_ar), joining the Turkish dictionary entry (dictionary/tr/{root_id}_entry.json) and the Turkish gloss record (translation/glosses/locales/tr/{root_id}.json) verbatim. Turkish is the only language with glosses/dictionary entries currently sourced (see coverage.root_lexicon). Every gloss error object (branches[].concept_gloss.error, branches[].contextual_glosses[].error, branches[].lexical_glosses{}.error) is annotated in place with a derived boolean `loses_core_concept`: true when error.fit == 'narrowing' AND error.loses_facet_ids is non-empty, i.e. this specific gloss text is materially incomplete about the root's core concept.

coverage.description: Mandatory coverage block: for each source, whether it was found and what was missing. A missing v12 response set is a machine-readable fact here, not a silent empty list.

word_morpheme_spans.description: Resolution of each word_analysis critical word to a MORPHEME SPAN via linguistic/morphemes.tsv. Critical words are orthographic/analytic units, not QAC words, so a critical word maps to a span of morphemes rather than to one qac_word_ref. Any unresolved word is listed explicitly in `unresolved`, never silently nulled.

scope.description: 'focus' = per-ayah stage_00 packet, already narrow, never scoped here. 'surah-fallback-scoped-to-ayah' = surah-wide packet narrowed by this builder. 'surah' = surah-wide packet emitted unscoped (presence-check path only).

scoping.description: What ayah-scoping did. Exists so that scoping can never be mistaken for absence: a root in dropped_roots was deliberately excluded, not missing upstream.

retained.description: Per retained root: which rule admitted it and how many branches were kept vs available. rule='in_ayah' always has branches_kept == branches_total.

citations_unresolvable_in_surah_inventor.description: Citations naming a root absent from the surah inventory entirely. These were unresolvable BEFORE scoping; recorded so the pre-existing gap is not attributed to scoping.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.description: Cross-layer identity check: do this ayah's word_analysis[].aligned_qac_word_ref values resolve against qac_morphemes.qac_word_ref? When consistent=false, word-level joins between word_analysis topics and QAC morphology are UNRELIABLE for this ayah -- word-analysis counts orthographic words where QAC counts morphological words. This is an upstream defect in quran-data's word-analysis and is deliberately NOT auto-repaired (renumbering would fabricate the stable identities PRINCIPLES.md §11 requires).

v12_reader_responses.description: present=false is expected in the default workflow because per-ayah focus-run responses are retired.

v12_reader_walks.description: A walk file that exists but yields zero recognised ayah headings at all is reported as present=false with zero_headings_parsed=true for that reader -- a distinct, loud state from a normal single-ayah 'heading not found' gap.

v12_reader_walks_wide.description: Coverage for the plus/minus-5 / 11-ayah reader-walk family.

v12_cross_run_publication.description: Coverage for compact final v12 cross-run findings.

butuncul_okuma.description: note distinguishes three states: no whole-surah reading file exists; file(s) exist but zero ayah lines parsed from any of them (unrecognised format -- never conflated with plain absence); or a working file with no line for this specific ayah.

channel_review.description: First-pass single-reader network-v3 channel review for the surah (see analysis/channels/network-v3/s{NNN}/review/reader_a_pilot.md). Not present for every surah.

root_lexicon.description: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.

per_root.description: Per root: presence of dictionary/gloss, plus occurrence_evidence_trimmed recording the exact concordance rows dropped for that root.

occurrence_evidence_trim.description: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are dropped from every root by design: a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, which dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for one common root). dictionary_entry.branches (the lexical concept material) is kept in full, as are occurrence_evidence.summary and .forms.

surahBundle.description: Emitted alongside the ayah bundles when build_bundle.py is run without --ayah. References the ayah bundle files by name rather than duplicating them, and carries surah-scope material that has no single-ayah home (the full Quran-text row set including the S:0 basmalah, and the full whole-surah reading).

ayah_bundle_files.description: Filenames of the sibling *.ayah.json files in the same output directory, in ayah order.

quran_text_all_rows.description: Every Quran-text row for the surah, including the S:0 prefatory basmalah row if present.

pericopes.description: The full ordered set of thematic ayah-span pericopes for this surah, from analysis/channels/network-v3/pericopes/surah_pericopes.jsonl. Surahs absent from that index get a single synthesized whole-surah row (synthesized=true) instead of being empty.

channel_generated_outputs.description: Same external generated channel-output manifest carried by ayah bundles, but at surah scope.

per_ayah.description: ayahRef -> that ayah bundle's own coverage block, verbatim.
